Haven Antiquity#000.src: Did you talk with the old creepy man in the mansion yet? I'm sure he knows something.
Haven Antiquity#000.dst: Já falou com o velho esquisito da mansão? Tenho certeza de que ele sabe de algo.

Haven Antiquity#001.src: I'd sit and tell you, but I feel you might get a better experience first hand....
Haven Antiquity#001.dst: Eu poderia te contar, mas acho que vai ser melhor viver isso em primeira mão....
Haven Antiquity#001.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#002.src: I can not cast the spell without the [{~} Umbral Essences] I asked for.
Haven Antiquity#002.dst: Não posso lançar o feitiço sem [{~} Umbral Essences] que pedi.
Haven Antiquity#002.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#005.src: If you die in the memory, you die in reality too.... Best of luck....
Haven Antiquity#005.dst: Se morrer na memória, morre na realidade também.... Boa sorte....

Haven Antiquity#006.src: Please go check out that egg. I am very worried about its behavior. Don't forget the [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#006.dst: Por favor, vá ver aquele ovo. Estou muito preocupado com ele. Não esqueça [{~} Monster Hides] como prova.

Haven Antiquity#007.src: Thank you for your work! I will be returning home. Perhaps we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#007.dst: Obrigada pelo trabalho! Vou voltar para casa. Quem sabe nos vemos de novo!

Haven Antiquity#008.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#008.dst: Fale com {p} nas docas de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#009.src: Hey there adventurer, can I speak with you for a second? I need you to do a spot of detective work for me.
Haven Antiquity#009.dst: Olá, aventureiro, posso falar com você um instante? Preciso que faça um trabalhinho de detetive pra mim.
Haven Antiquity#009.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#010.src: My grandfather once told me how beautiful this place was, and how to visit here if I wanted to relax.
Haven Antiquity#010.dst: Meu avô me contou como este lugar era lindo, e que eu viesse aqui se quisesse relaxar.
Haven Antiquity#010.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#011.src: But as you can see, this island is the least bit relaxing. It is a sorrowful place, corrupted and dark.
Haven Antiquity#011.dst: Mas como você vê, esta ilha não tem nada de relaxante. É um lugar triste, corrompido e sombrio.
Haven Antiquity#011.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#012.src: This can't be right. My grandfather was an honest man, he wouldn't have lied.
Haven Antiquity#012.dst: Não pode ser. Meu avô era um homem honesto, ele não teria mentido.
Haven Antiquity#012.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#013.src: I figure something must have happened. I really want to know how it got like this.
Haven Antiquity#013.dst: Algo deve ter acontecido. Quero muito saber como ficou assim.
Haven Antiquity#013.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#014.src: There's an old creepy man living up on that hill in a big mansion who seems just old enough to know what happened. It might be a good place to start.
Haven Antiquity#014.dst: Tem um velho esquisito morando numa mansão grande naquela colina, velho o bastante para saber o que houve. Pode ser um bom começo.
Haven Antiquity#014.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#015.src: Investigate Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#015.dst: Investigue o velho Siwel na mansão morta em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#016.src: What do you want? I'm busy. Brewing potions takes focus, you know....
Haven Antiquity#016.dst: O que quer? Estou ocupado. Preparar poções exige foco, sabe....
Haven Antiquity#016.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#017.src: Oh, you want to know about the island's history? Well you certainly came to the right man. I've lived here for a very long time.
Haven Antiquity#017.dst: Ah, quer saber da história da ilha? Pois veio ao homem certo. Moro aqui há muito tempo.
Haven Antiquity#017.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#018.src: There is a way for you to see for yourself what happened here. It's quite... an interesting tale, too.
Haven Antiquity#018.dst: Há um jeito de você ver com os próprios olhos o que houve aqui. É uma história... bem interessante.
Haven Antiquity#018.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#019.src: Using some of the more... frowned upon methods in the alchemists library I am able to send you into the 'memory' of a dead person that lived here at the time.
Haven Antiquity#019.dst: Com uns métodos... malvistos da biblioteca alquímica, posso te mandar para a 'memória' de um morto que viveu aqui na época.
Haven Antiquity#019.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#020.src: It will require a little work from you though, if you wish to proceed....
Haven Antiquity#020.dst: Mas vai exigir um pouco de trabalho seu, se quiser continuar....
Haven Antiquity#020.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#021.src: Bring me [{~} Umbral Essences] and I will be able to cast a spell on you which will allow you to pass into the 'memory' of the deceased.
Haven Antiquity#021.dst: Traga [{~} Umbral Essences] e poderei lançar em você um feitiço que te deixará entrar na 'memória' do falecido.
Haven Antiquity#021.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#022.src: Acquire [{~} Umbral Essences] for Old Siwel
Haven Antiquity#022.dst: Consiga [{~} Umbral Essences] para o velho Siwel

Haven Antiquity#023.src: Excellent. You acquired the ingredients. Just give me a second and I'll prepare you for your journey into the mind of the dead.
Haven Antiquity#023.dst: Excelente. Conseguiu os ingredientes. Um momento e vou te preparar para a jornada à mente dos mortos.
Haven Antiquity#023.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#024.src: There, look into my eyes. Yes, you're ready. Ah, there is a drawback though....
Haven Antiquity#024.dst: Pronto, olhe nos meus olhos. Sim, está pronto. Ah, mas há um porém....
Haven Antiquity#024.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#025.src: Once you are inside the memory, it will feel like you are actually there. You won't be able to return until you have succeeded in your task.
Haven Antiquity#025.dst: Dentro da memória, vai parecer que você está lá de verdade. Não poderá voltar até cumprir sua tarefa.
Haven Antiquity#025.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#026.src: To enter the memory, you need to find the dead man at the end of the crypt in the graveyard.
Haven Antiquity#026.dst: Para entrar na memória, encontre o morto no fim da cripta do cemitério.
Haven Antiquity#026.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#027.src: The dead roam those caves in heavy numbers, so watch your step.
Haven Antiquity#027.dst: Os mortos vagam em bando por essas cavernas, então cuidado.
Haven Antiquity#027.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#028.src: Oh and one more thing, If you die in the memory, you die in reality too....
Haven Antiquity#028.dst: Ah, e mais uma coisa: se morrer na memória, morre na realidade também....
Haven Antiquity#028.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#030.src: Locate the Crypt under the church at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and pass through a dead man's memory
Haven Antiquity#030.dst: Encontre a cripta sob a igreja em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e atravesse a memória de um morto

Haven Antiquity#031.src: Investigate Siwel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] on Alive Island
Haven Antiquity#031.dst: Investigue Siwel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] na Ilha dos Vivos

Haven Antiquity#032.src: Oh, hello there. Would you mind helping me with something for a second?
Haven Antiquity#032.dst: Ah, olá. Pode me ajudar com uma coisa rapidinho?
Haven Antiquity#032.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#033.src: Recently, some strange things have been happening to the miners around here. New diseases, unexplained disappearances, and things like that.
Haven Antiquity#033.dst: Ultimamente, coisas estranhas andam acontecendo com os mineiros daqui. Doenças novas, sumiços sem explicação e coisas assim.
Haven Antiquity#033.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#034.src: The villagers have been getting very worried. So, in an attempt to protect the island, I bought a strange egg and placed it in a cave close to town.
Haven Antiquity#034.dst: Os aldeões estão muito preocupados. Então, para proteger a ilha, comprei um ovo estranho e coloquei numa caverna perto da vila.
Haven Antiquity#034.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#035.src: The egg, however, isn't what I thought it was. It is producing monsters and giving off some sort of dark aura.
Haven Antiquity#035.dst: Mas o ovo não é o que eu pensava. Ele está gerando monstros e soltando uma espécie de aura sombria.
Haven Antiquity#035.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#036.src: I want you to go check out that egg. See if you can get rid of whatever it is producing. Bring me [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#036.dst: Quero que vá ver aquele ovo. Veja se consegue se livrar do que ele está gerando. Traga [{~} Monster Hides] como prova.
Haven Antiquity#036.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#037.src: Confront the cave under the mansion at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and retrieve [{~} Monster Hides] for Siwel from the monsters within
Haven Antiquity#037.dst: Enfrente a caverna sob a mansão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e consiga [{~} Monster Hides] dos monstros lá dentro para Siwel

Haven Antiquity#038.src: You're back! Were you able to stop that egg?
Haven Antiquity#038.dst: Você voltou! Conseguiu deter aquele ovo?
Haven Antiquity#038.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#039.src: No? Well, I guess we'll have to wait and see what it hatches into.
Haven Antiquity#039.dst: Não? Bem, acho que teremos que esperar para ver o que sai dele.
Haven Antiquity#039.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#040.src: I see you got some rather rare dark monster hide. Maybe I could use those in a potion for something, maybe to prolong life.
Haven Antiquity#040.dst: Vejo que trouxe um couro de monstro sombrio bem raro. Talvez eu use numa poção para algo, talvez prolongar a vida.
Haven Antiquity#040.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#041.src: Some of the villagers believe that it is unwise for myself to dabble in the dark arts, dealing with mysterious eggs and brewing potions of death.
Haven Antiquity#041.dst: Alguns aldeões acham imprudente eu mexer com artes sombrias, lidar com ovos misteriosos e preparar poções de morte.
Haven Antiquity#041.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#042.src: I'll outlive them all, you'll see!
Haven Antiquity#042.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#043.src: As for you, you have done what I asked. You may return to your personal affairs now.
Haven Antiquity#043.dst: Quanto a você, fez o que pedi. Pode voltar aos seus assuntos agora.
Haven Antiquity#043.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#044.src: Thank you for your work, though. Only time will tell what that egg will hatch into.
Haven Antiquity#044.dst: Mas obrigado pelo trabalho. Só o tempo dirá o que vai sair daquele ovo.
Haven Antiquity#044.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#045.src: Return to Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#045.dst: Volte ao velho Siwel na mansão morta em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#046.src: What? You... you made it back? Oh... Very well. Alchemy can be a... dangerous practice.
Haven Antiquity#046.dst: O quê? Você... você voltou? Ah... Muito bem. A alquimia pode ser... um ofício perigoso.
Haven Antiquity#046.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#047.src: Anyone who tried to find out the island's history came to me at some point, and I sent them on a one way street to a memory. But not you....
Haven Antiquity#047.dst: Todos que tentaram descobrir a história da ilha vieram a mim, e eu os mandei sem volta para uma memória. Mas não você....
Haven Antiquity#047.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#048.src: So now you know my dreadful secret, I am racked with guilt and cursed with eternal life.
Haven Antiquity#048.dst: Então agora sabe meu terrível segredo: a culpa me consome e a vida eterna me amaldiçoa.
Haven Antiquity#048.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#049.src: There is no need to fight me, I am suffering enough for what I... wrought on this island.
Haven Antiquity#049.dst: Não precisa lutar comigo, já sofro o bastante pelo que... causei nesta ilha.
Haven Antiquity#049.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#050.src: I could not destroy the egg. It hatched into a... monstrous beast that cursed this island until this very day.
Haven Antiquity#050.dst: Não consegui destruir o ovo. Dele nasceu uma... fera monstruosa que amaldiçoou esta ilha até hoje.
Haven Antiquity#050.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#051.src: A powerful warrior from... {p} slew the beast, yet the island did not rejuvenate....
Haven Antiquity#051.dst: Um guerreiro poderoso de... {p} matou a fera, mas a ilha não se recuperou....
Haven Antiquity#051.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#052.src: I leave the bones of the beast as a reminder of my failure, the destruction it brought still... lingers in the monsters it left behind.
Haven Antiquity#052.dst: Deixo os ossos da fera como lembrete do meu fracasso; a destruição que ela trouxe ainda... vive nos monstros que deixou.
Haven Antiquity#052.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#053.src: So adventurer, now you have the knowledge of what I have done. You may tell the others down in the village, as it is no longer a secret.
Haven Antiquity#053.dst: Pois bem, aventureiro, agora sabe o que fiz. Pode contar aos outros lá na vila, pois já não é segredo.
Haven Antiquity#053.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#054.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about the mystery
Haven Antiquity#054.dst: Fale com {p} nas docas em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] sobre o mistério

Haven Antiquity#055.src: So, did you find out what happened?
Haven Antiquity#055.dst: E aí, descobriu o que aconteceu?
Haven Antiquity#055.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#056.src: Siwel was the one who caused this sorrow? He does have a very dark presence about him, doesn't he?
Haven Antiquity#056.dst: Siwel foi quem causou essa tristeza? Ele tem mesmo uma presença bem sombria, não é?
Haven Antiquity#056.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#057.src: Thank you for your work! I know it must have been tough getting that out of him.
Haven Antiquity#057.dst: Obrigada pelo trabalho! Sei que deve ter sido difícil arrancar isso dele.
Haven Antiquity#057.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#058.src: Now that this mystery is solved I will be returning home. I hope we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#058.dst: Agora que o mistério foi resolvido, volto pra casa. Espero que nos vejamos de novo!
Haven Antiquity#058.speaker: Cinfras
